instruction: Logical Assessment 10: Analyze the space vs time complexity tradeoff of memoization.
response:
Analysis:
- Time Complexity: Reduced from exponential O(2^n) to linear O(n) by caching subproblem results.
- Space Complexity: Increased from O(n) call stack to O(n) auxiliary hash table/array storage.
Conclusion: Memoization trades memory consumption for dramatic CPU execution speedup. (Reasoning variant 10)
